evidence.text: Principal Data Engineer and design authority for the plant data platform of an industrial manufacturer since 2023, spanning the ingestion team and the serving team; senior data engineer on the ingestion team from 2019 to 2023.
evidence.notes: Directly states design authority spanning two teams.

evidence.text: Owner of the platform's reference architecture, implemented by both teams, and holder of the platform's seat on the company's engineering review board, where the six architecture proposals of the last three years were presented under my name; the proposals and the board minutes are in the architecture repository.
evidence.notes: Shows ownership and review board participation.

evidence.text: Chaired the platform's technical standards group, which met fortnightly under the group's standards process and issued eleven standards in that period, each with a change record.
evidence.notes: Demonstrates chairing a standards group under a documented process.

evidence.text: Coached the four senior engineers of the two teams under the engineering coaching programme, with the coaching agreements filed with the engineering managers.
evidence.notes: Shows coaching under a documented programme.

evidence.text: Recorded in each architecture proposal and each standard what it left open, in the 'not decided here' section that the standards process requires.
